BILL NUMBER:  S2230

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to authorize approval of a certain transportation contract of
the Whitehall central school district


 PURPOSE :
To legalize, validate, ratify and confirm actions taken by the
Whitehall Central School District relating to or in connection with a
certain transportation contract for the 2007-2008 school year, which
provided transportation to and from the New York State School for the
Blind in Batavia.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Section one - legalizes, validates, ratifies and confirms actions
taken by the Whitehall Central School District relating to or in
connection with a certain transportation contract for the 2007-2008
school year, which provided transportation to and from the New York
State School for the Blind in Batavia

Section two - the education department is hereby directed to consider
the aforementioned contract for transportation aid as valid and proper
obligations of the Whitehall central school district

Section three - contains the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :
Due to a misinterpretation of the state bidding requirements Whitehall
Central School District did not publish the "Bid Notice" for a
transportation contract to Batavia School for the Blind for the
required length of time, for the 2007-08 school year. As a result of
the late request for transportation the "Bid Notice" was advertised
four days between publication and opening of the bid rather then the
required five days. The Whitehall Central School official newspaper is
published once a week on Thursday; therefore the notice was published
on August 30, 2007 and the bids were opened on September 4, with
transportation beginning on September 5. The school district
inadvertently interpreted the law to state that the advertisement had
to appear for five days only, and could be opened on the sixth day. As
a result of this misunderstanding the State Education Department has
denied approval of$50,717 for the 200708 State transportation aid
contract for neglecting to publish one additional day. This
legislation would direct the State Education Department to approve the
transportation aid payment notwithstanding the notice requirement

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New bill; Similar legislation for the 2006-07 year was signed into law
as Chapter 449 of 2008

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
This legislation would authorize the State Education Department to pay
$50,717 to the Whitehall Central School District.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
The act shall take effect immediately.
